tasks.subject: Task 1: Solution skeleton with all projects and references (dependency rule wired)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create `EMaigrator.sln` under `/src` with every production and test project from DESIGN.md §15 / CONTRACTS §8 and project references that physically enforce the dependency rule.

**Files:**
Create: `src/EMaigrator.sln`, `src/EMaigrator.Core/EMaigrator.Core.csproj`, `src/EMaigrator.Connectors.Imap/EMaigrator.Connectors.Imap.csproj`, `src/EMaigrator.Connectors.Graph/EMaigrator.Connectors.Graph.csproj`, `src/EMaigrator.Connectors.Gmail/EMaigrator.Connectors.Gmail.csproj`, `src/EMaigrator.Infrastructure/EMaigrator.Infrastructure.csproj`, `src/EMaigrator.Workers/EMaigrator.Workers.csproj`, `src/EMaigrator.Api/EMaigrator.Api.csproj`, `src/EMaigrator.Cli/EMaigrator.Cli.csproj`
Test: `src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests`, `src/EMaigrator.Connectors.Imap.Tests`, `src/EMaigrator.Connectors.Graph.Tests`, `src/EMaigrator.Connectors.Gmail.Tests`, `src/EMaigrator.Infrastructure.Tests`, `src/EMaigrator.Infrastructure.IntegrationTests`, `src/EMaigrator.Workers.Tests`, `src/EMaigrator.Workers.IntegrationTests`, `src/EMaigrator.Api.Tests`, `src/EMaigrator.Cli.Tests` (each `<name>/<name>.csproj`)
Create (verification helper): `src/structure-check.ps1`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `dotnet sln src/EMaigrator.sln list` lists all 8 production projects and all 10 test projects.
- `EMaigrator.Core.csproj` has zero `<ProjectReference>` elements.
- Connectors (Imap/Graph/Gmail) and Infrastructure each reference only `EMaigrator.Core`.
- Workers references Core+Infrastructure+3 connectors; Api references Core+Infrastructure+Workers; Cli references Core+Infrastructure+Workers+3 connectors.
- No connector references another connector or Infrastructure.
- `dotnet build src/EMaigrator.sln` succeeds.

**Verify:** `dotnet build src/EMaigrator.sln -c Release` → `Build succeeded` with `0 Warning(s)` and `0 Error(s)`; `dotnet sln src/EMaigrator.sln list` lists 18 projects.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Directory.Build.props — nullable, langversion, analyzers, warnaserror, central package versions
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add a repo-wide `Directory.Build.props` and `Directory.Packages.props` enforcing net10.0, nullable, C# 13, latest analyzers, warnings-as-errors, and central package version management across every project.

**Files:**
Create: `src/Directory.Build.props`, `src/Directory.Packages.props`, `src/props-check.ps1`
Modify: every generated `.csproj` (remove per-project TFM/Nullable/LangVersion/ImplicitUsings; convert test PackageReferences to versionless central form)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Every project inherits `<Nullable>enable</Nullable>`, `<LangVersion>13.0</LangVersion>`, `<TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>`, `<ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>` from Directory.Build.props.
- `<TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors>`, `<EnableNETAnalyzers>true</EnableNETAnalyzers>`, `<AnalysisLevel>latest-recommended</AnalysisLevel>` set repo-wide.
- `<ManagePackageVersionsCentrally>true</ManagePackageVersionsCentrally>` on; versions in Directory.Packages.props.
- A deliberate unused-variable probe fails the build (proves warnaserror).
- `dotnet build src/EMaigrator.sln -c Release` succeeds with `0 Warning(s)`.

**Verify:** `dotnet build src/EMaigrator.sln -c Release /p:TreatWarningsAsErrors=true` → `Build succeeded`, `0 Warning(s)`, `0 Error(s)`.


tasks.subject: Task 3: Architecture dependency-rule test (NetArchTest) + solution smoke test
tasks.description:

**Files:**
Create: `src/EMaigrator.Core/AssemblyMarker.cs`, `src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests/Architecture/DependencyRuleTests.cs`, `src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests/SmokeTests.cs`
Modify: `src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests/EMaigrator.Core.Tests.csproj`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `EMaigrator.Core.Tests` references NetArchTest.Rules (versionless) and the Infrastructure + 3 connector projects (test-only references to name forbidden assemblies).
- `DependencyRuleTests.Core_DoesNotDependOn_AnyHigherLayer` passes.
- `SmokeTests.Harness_Runs` passes.
- Adding a `using EMaigrator.Infrastructure;` dependency to Core makes the architecture test FAIL (demonstrated then reverted).

tasks.subject: Task 6: CI workflow — build, test+coverage, vulnerability audit, web build+vitest
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add a GitHub Actions workflow that builds the solution, runs all .NET tests with coverage, runs `dotnet list package --vulnerable --include-transitive` and fails the job on any finding, and builds the web app + runs Vitest.

**Files:**
Create: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `scripts/check-vulnerable.ps1`, `src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests/CiScriptTests.cs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `ci.yml` `dotnet` job: setup-dotnet 10.x, restore, build -c Release, test with `--collect:"XPlat Code Coverage"`, then runs `scripts/check-vulnerable.ps1`.
- `check-vulnerable.ps1` runs `dotnet list package --vulnerable --include-transitive` and exits non-zero on any vulnerability row (advisory `>` marker / "has the following vulnerable packages").
- `ci.yml` `web` job: setup-node 24.x, `npm ci`, `npm run build`, `npm run test -- --run`.
- A unit test verifies the script: clean fixture → exit 0; vulnerable fixture → non-zero exit.
- Workflow is valid YAML.

**Verify:** `dotnet test src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests --filter "FullyQualifiedName~CiScriptTests"` → all pass (2 passed).

tasks.subject: Task 8: Security Verification — vulnerability gate fails on a finding + no secrets committed
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove this plan's security focus from the INDEX per-plan table: CI's `dotnet list package --vulnerable` gate actually fails the build on a real finding, and no secrets are committed (`.gitignore` verified).

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in acceptanceCriteria has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
Create: `src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests/Security/VulnerabilityGateTests.cs`, `src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests/Security/SecretsHygieneTests.cs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `scripts/check-vulnerable.ps1 -InputFile <fixture-with-a-real-advisory-row>` exits non-zero (gate trips on a finding) — captured in test output.
- `scripts/check-vulnerable.ps1 -InputFile <fixture-clean>` exits zero (no false positive) — captured.
- Live audit over the actual solution passes today: `pwsh -File scripts/check-vulnerable.ps1` exits 0 over `src/EMaigrator.sln` — captured.
- `.gitignore` contains entries for `.env`, `.env.*`, `*.pem`, `secrets.json`, `appsettings.*.local.json` — verified by test reading the file.
- `git ls-files` shows zero tracked files matching secret patterns (`.env` excluding `.env.example`, `*.pem`, `secrets.json`, `appsettings.*.local.json`) — verified by test.
- `deploy/.env.example` values are placeholders (`change-me`); `deploy/.env` is not tracked.

**Verify:** `dotnet test src/EMaigrator.Core.Tests --filter "FullyQualifiedName~Security"` → all pass (covers gate-trips-on-finding, gate-clean, live-audit-clean, gitignore, and zero-tracked-secrets).
